account: BattlegroundAI describes advertising for an unnamed advocacy organization supporting school-board candidates in Virginia, Michigan, and North Carolina. The vendor reports that AI-generated copy accounted for five of the ten highest click-through rates and five of the lowest costs per click. Its submission to the AI Opportunity Inventory also claims a 9% reduction in advertising costs and a 16–32% increase in reach, but the linked Analyst Institute account was inaccessible during this review. Those percentages remain submission-level claims. The public summaries do not provide the comparison design or isolate AI from human editing, targeting, spending, and platform delivery. Election wins are not evidence that AI caused electoral success. The date records access to the undated vendor account, not the campaign dates.

fields.account: BattlegroundAI describes advertising for an unnamed advocacy organization supporting school-board candidates in Virginia, Michigan, and North Carolina. The vendor reports that AI-generated copy accounted for five of the ten highest click-through rates and five of the lowest costs per click. Its submission to the AI Opportunity Inventory also claims a 9% reduction in advertising costs and a 16–32% increase in reach, but the linked Analyst Institute account was inaccessible during this review. Those percentages remain submission-level claims. The public summaries do not provide the comparison design or isolate AI from human editing, targeting, spending, and platform delivery. Election wins are not evidence that AI caused electoral success. The date records access to the undated vendor account, not the campaign dates.
